tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Service provider needs to submit the firm registration certificates and Karnataka labour department Registration Certificate
Provident fund (PF) Registration Certificate along with PF payment receipts for payment done to employees before 15th of every month
ESI department Registration Certificate with ESI payment confirmation receipts for payment done to employees before 15th of every month
Filed copies of Income tax returns

The contract will be awarded for three years, with yearly renewal, based on the performance of the Service provider. The tender inviting authority reserves the right to cancel the tender anytime during the contract period if the performance of the service provider is not satisfactory.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should furnish documentary evidence for having satisfactorily completed atleast one similar contract of providing services of minimum 11 Labours Attach Experience Certificate issued by the Employer of State Government / Central Government / State or Central undertaking boards / Urban local bodies )
Tenderer Should Furnish Bank account statement details of Salary Transfer to the Employees Related to Work Experience Submitted in the Tender

The tenderer should furnish valid copy of REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE OF THE ESTABLISHMENT WITH DEPARTMENT OF LABOUR, GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA (Attach valid Registration Certificate of agency obtained from the issuing authorities)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE OF THE ESTABLISHMENT WITH DEPARTMENT OF LABOUR

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should furnish valid copy of Provident fund (PF) Registration Certificate (Attach valid Registration Certificate of agency obtained from the issuing authorities) Attach PF payment receipts for payment done to employees before 15th of every month

The tenderer should furnish valid copy of ESI department Registration Certificate (Attach valid Registration Certificate of agency obtained from the issuing authorities) Attach ESI payment receipts for payment done to employees before 15th of every month
The tenderer should furnish valid copy of GST Certificate & PAN Card (Attach valid Registration Certificate of agency obtained from the issuing authorities)

Tenderer firm/company should not be blacklisted by any government organization. The Tenderer shall furnish an Affidavit for not having Black Listed earlier by the Firm / Company represented by its Proprietor / Partners / Directors / Chairman / Managing Director / Office Bearers in the Business Transactions of any Government / Semi-Government / Government Undertaking / Public Sector Organizations / any other Departments.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- AFFIDAVIT FOR NOT HAVING BLACKLISTED

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have achieved in last five years in atleast two financial years annual financial turnover of Rupees 57.00 Lakhs (Attach Certified balance sheet issued by Charted accountant (With profit loss statement)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Each tenderer should further demonstrate Liquid assets and / or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs 9.00lakhs (credit lines/letter of credit/certificates from bank for meeting the fund requirement etc) (CONDITIONAL BANKERS CERTIFICATES WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED)
The tenderer should furnish filed copies of Income Tax for the last three years.
